title: Would you play this game?
author: KwonDarko
selftext: This game uses a custom built game engine, assisted by Claude, here is the url: [https://github.com/tomicz/tomicz-ai-game-engine](https://github.com/tomicz/tomicz-ai-game-engine)

comments.author: Upstairs_Weird_760
comments.body: That gave me zero context on what the game is about....

replies.author: KwonDarko
replies.body:
It's a teaser, hence why not much info about it. 

It's a survival camping game, still in development. I'll share more next week.

replies.author: Cool-Chemical-5629
replies.body:
Would we play what? Open world full of nothing?

Sure, now you admit it's just a teaser to a game that is still in development for which you'll share more next week.

However, the title of your post already asked "Would you play this game?" as if the game was ready or as if the teaser itself at the very least showed actual gameplay that would give a hint as to what the game is about. It did not do that, so you can't blame people for pointing out the obvious.

If and when you do have actual gameplay to show next week, that question from the title of your post may be more relevant.

replies.author: Pure_Parking_2742
replies.body: Why ask at this point? You're throwing out a nothing burger and expecting people to bite it. Build some actual systems and then let your audience decide.

comments.author: Impressive_Award_679
comments.body: Dude this shows nothing. I can drive a car in thousands of games xD Why you've made a costum engine for a car driving simulation like this? Or whats the game about?

comments.author: EasyTarget973
comments.body:
I'm getting so sick of these posts that ask dumb questions. WHAT GAME, A JEEP IS DRIVING OVER TERRAIN, AS A PLAYER I DONT GIVE A SHIT ITS A CUSTOM ENGINE. This is why AI is getting hate, and **don't get me wrong, nothing you're showing here is bad**, it's just the framing your putting on it. sorry for the rant.

I really wish people would put themselves in the consumer position, like would you pay $20 to drive a jeep down a hill? That's what you are selling with this.

comments.author: BanjoThunderbird
comments.body:
**"Custom engine"** Players don't care unless you actually did something which other engines can't. What's special about your engine? Why is it meaningful that your game was built on a custom engine rather than Unity or Unreal?

**"Built from scratch"** I mean yeah you just said that.

**"Custom game"** No shit, I'd hope you didn't build an engine just to clone someone's game. Why even have this line? Is this supposed to be saying that people can mod it and make custom game modes? I don't understand.

I don't know if I'd play because I literally know nothing about the game. But this trailer would genuinely piss me off enough to avoid it.

comments.author: ZuhkoYi
comments.body: Damn this post is a shitshow. The comments are right... go back and work on this before trying to promote... nothing

comments.body: Can I drive down a cliff and explode in this

comments.author: ZenCyberDad
comments.body: I mean if I was a Jeep executive maybe? Can you step out of the car? Is there gas? Is there a day night cycle? Missions?

comments.author: FridgeBaron
comments.body: I have no issue with anything being AI coded. I have an issue with the fact this has 0 game and you thought grass seizuring in front of the camera looks good? Like, to be a bit rude but if you put that jittery mess as the first thing we see what should we honestly expect from the rest of the game? I know its just a "teaser" and you don't want to spend that long making it if you are trying to figure out if people would actually want the game. But like, its a survival game and you don't even have a character model?
